page.overview:
Who is Samin Moro?

Samin Moro was a Mentat in the service of House Harkonnen.

Samin Moro was approached by the Prisoner in Riftwatch and offered to train them the ways of the Mentat. She told them that they would need to provide simple yet necessary tasks to prove their capability before the training could begin. Once these tasks were completed, she informed them that she was skilled in the art of killing, which was very useful to her colleague, Piter de Vries.
